name: E2E Docs - Local Sandbox Mounts

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/local-sandbox.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/filesystem/local-filesystem.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/mount-manager.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/sandbox.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/types.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/mount.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/workspace.ts'
      - 'packages/core/tests/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/local-sandbox.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/filesystem/local-filesystem.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/mount-manager.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/sandbox.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/types.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/sandbox/mount.ts'
      - 'packages/core/src/workspace.ts'
      - 'packages/core/tests/**'

jobs:
  e2e-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build core package
        run: npm run build -w @mastra/core

      - name: Run LocalSandbox Mount Tests
        run: npm test -w @mastra/core -- --testPathPattern="local-sandbox" --testNamePattern="mount"

      - name: Run Workspace & LocalFilesystem Tests
        run: npm test -w @mastra/core -- --testPathPattern="workspace|local-filesystem" --testNamePattern="contained|getMountConfig"

      - name: Type Check
        run: npm run typecheck -w @mastra/core

      - name: Lint Check
        run: npm run lint -w @mastra/core
